The common first probe is initialized as paid evidence with no agent event or model call, so no extra step is needed.240000 is the reported input-plus-output-token stopping threshold between calls; the final paid call can exceed it. compute_note: Hegel interpreter/search operations and Code scored prediction operations are distinct measurements. Report Code model calls, input/output/cached tokens, Python execution time and provider wall time separately; reported total tokens include cached inputs and are not generated tokens or monetary cost.
source_contract: Both arms receive the identical paid source observations and transitions, learned calibration, known source family/radius and initial open radius interval. Code receives equivalent ordinary Python source rather than a Hegel candidate library. Source acquisition is reused and counted once per apparatus. For relation-only, reuse only the already-paid correct_input_control preparation, not any later current-task acquisition or terminal result. Cases reset to that common source independently.
exposure_contract: LLM workspace and task descriptions use neutral case_0/case_1/case_2 labels; causal condition labels, environment implementation/private parameters, Hegel post-change revisions and terminal outcomes are absent. The prescribed nine-row counterexample is acquired and charged identically before free Code research.
evaluation_gate: All Code cases in this cohort must stop learning before any Code terminal scoring. Reuse completed Hegel terminal results without rerunning Hegel. Terminal targets and failures never enter another case learning state.

historical_code_reference.note: Completed earlier task families are inventory only. The earlier CLI default was recorded as gpt-5.5/xhigh; this comparison records the current effective model explicitly and does not pool prior Code outcomes.
